purpose: Native importer handoff package for the next states after Ohio and Wisconsin.
notes: These packages point to official source artifacts already present in this repository.
Generated *-app-data.js bundles are listed only as reference outputs; native ETL should parse the official artifacts directly.
County geometry is available for these three states. Precinct/ward boundary geometry is not included in this package.
The sourceDiscoveryQueue tracks states where official local reporting-unit artifacts still need collection before native advisory flags can be calculated under the current methodology.

County-only presidential/result tables are not sufficient for comparable advisory flag generation; each review-capable state needs President plus a same-row comparison contest at precinct, ward, town, or equivalent local reporting-unit level.
